description: This file contains the code-behind for the ExamResult page in an online examination system. It manages displaying the exam results, updating user statistics in the database, and navigation controls such as home, profile, leaderboard, and logout.

classes.name: ExamResult
classes.description: Code-behind class for the ExamResult ASP.NET WebForm, handling page load events and button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, fetches session variables, updates user exam statistics in the database, and displays results on the webpage.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the UserProfile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout and navigates to the LoginPage.
